trustlink.title: TrustLink — Enterprise Identity & SSO Platform (OAuth 2.0 & OIDC)
trustlink.role: SLT Internship — Core Identity & Security Lead
trustlink.privateMessage: Private Enterprise Repository — Proprietary source code developed during SLT Internship under organization access control (NDA). Direct source code access is restricted.
trustlink.description: Full-stack OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect Single Sign-On identity provider with passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, PKCE, signed JWTs, and automated risk scoring.
highlights: Developed a full-stack OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect identity provider with Authorization Code Flow + PKCE, signed JWTs, JWKS discovery, and refresh token rotation.
Integrated passwordless FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys and Email/SMS OTP verification to enable single sign-on across enterprise telecom services.
Designed a sign-in activity and security logging pipeline with automated risk scoring and suspicious-login email alerts.
Built a React, Redux Toolkit and Tailwind CSS admin console with RBAC, analytics dashboards, and light/dark theming.
Containerized with Docker and Nginx, applying rate limiting and vulnerability scanning.

trust-pass.title: TrustPass — Flight Booking & Seat Reservation App (SLT TrustLink OIDC)
trust-pass.description: Cross-platform Flutter application for Flight Ticket Booking, Airbus A380 Fuselage Seat Reservation, and QR Boarding Passes, integrated with Sign in with SLT (TrustLink OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect PKCE) and automated Cloud APK CI/CD.
highlights: Engineered a cross-platform Flutter application for multi-leg flight ticket booking, dynamic Airbus A380 fuselage seat selection, and QR boarding passes.
Integrated Sign in with SLT powered by TrustLink OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect with RFC 7636 S256 PKCE authorization code flow.
Automated Cloud APK Build and Release pipelines using GitHub Actions CI/CD for continuous mobile delivery.
Implemented instant demo login, verified passenger claim synchronization, and offline-first QR pass rendering.

zendata.title: ZenData — Automated Data Quality & Semantic Hygiene Platform
zendata.description: 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine & semantic hygiene pipeline that evaluates datasets, reconciles financial formulas, and generates executive PDF/Excel audit scorecards.
highlights: Engineered a 4-Pillar Data Health Audit Engine evaluating Completeness, Uniqueness, Validity, and Statistical Consistency (1.5x IQR outlier detection) for 0–100% quality scores.
Implemented Semantic Hygiene & Anti-Poisoning Rules in Pandas to purge sentinel placeholders and cluster categorical typos without fabricating missing PII.
Designed Mathematical Reconciliation Logic cross-validating financial formulas (Total = Qty x Price x (1 - Discount)) to reverse-engineer corrupted totals.
Automated Executive Reporting Pipelines with ReportLab and OpenPyXL to generate landscape PDF scorecards and 3-sheet styled Excel workbooks.

loan-approval-prediction.title: Loan Approval Prediction System
loan-approval-prediction.description: End-to-end machine learning classification pipeline predicting loan approvals across 58,645 financial records with 99.97% accuracy and 1.0 AUC-ROC.
highlights: Built an end-to-end ML classification pipeline in Python on a 58,645-record financial dataset.
Performed EDA and data cleaning: missing value imputation, IQR outlier capping, feature encoding, and scaling.
Trained Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and KNN classifiers with stratified train-test split, achieving up to 99.97% accuracy and AUC-ROC of 1.0.
Optimised model performance using GridSearchCV with 5-fold cross-validation across multiple hyperparameter combinations.

suspicious-log-analyzer.title: Suspicious Log Analyzer — Security Mini-Project
suspicious-log-analyzer.description: Real-time Python security incident response tool that monitors server access logs, tracks IP behavior, and flags brute-force attacks for firewall blocking.
highlights: Developed a Python-based incident response tool to monitor server access logs and detect unauthorized access attempts.
Utilized data mining techniques and dictionary structures to track IP behavior and authentication statuses in real time.
Implemented a threat-detection threshold to automatically flag potential brute-force attacks for firewall blocking.

spotit-lk.title: Civic Engagement & Feedback Platform — SpotIT LK
spotit-lk.description: SDG 11-aligned civic engagement mobile platform enabling citizens to report public issues with compressed multimedia evidence synced in real time to government dashboards.
highlights: Architected and implemented the multimedia storage infrastructure enabling citizens to attach photo evidence to public issue reports.
Integrated Firebase Cloud Storage to securely host, manage, and retrieve user-generated media for government dashboards.
Developed seamless image capture, compression, and upload workflows in Flutter optimized for low-bandwidth networks.
Collaborated on client-server synchronization across Flutter, Firebase Firestore, and cloud storage services supporting SDG Goal 11.
